text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Craft, thank you for the birthday present!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"That's such a wonderful mobile. It even 
has cute candle decorations on it♪"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh. Do you like it? Actually, I made 
it with you in mind, Cesario.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Me? Ah... Come to think of it, there were 
two kinds of candles, weren't there?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Something that blazes furiously, and 
something colored in gentle, serene 
tones...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yep! Cesario when she's running, and 
Cesario when she's doing anything else! I 
decided on it after observing you closely 
from morning till night.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Ah, from morning till night... That's kind 
of embarrassing, honestly.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... maybe that's just the vibe I get! 
Cesario always gives off this feeling of 
having a warm light glowing within her.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Whether fierce or gentle... even if the 
flickering flame changes, its brilliance 
never fades!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"...N-No... That's quite the killer line, 
you know?"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Geez. You really can't let your guard down 
around here.
